title: Partial backpropagation for efficient neural network training and adaptation

creators.name: Pinto Neto, Osmar
creators.affiliation: Department of Kinesiology, California State University San Marcos

description:
Frozen experiment source, protocols, processed evidence and portable analysis replays supporting Partial backpropagation for efficient neural network training and adaptation. The collection examines gradient omission, optimizer-state behavior and optimized execution across CNN training, ViT training and adaptation, and independent Oxford-IIIT Pet adaptation.

Licensing is file-specific: original software is licensed under Apache License 2.0; original protocols, processed evidence, figures and documentation are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International. Third-party software retains its upstream licenses and notices. The record-level Apache-2.0 label describes the software and does not relicense the research artifacts. See LICENSE.md and the included license texts for the complete scope.

Portable analysis replays reconstruct selected results from included evidence. Raw datasets, pretrained weights and model checkpoints are not bundled; full training replication requires the documented external prerequisites. This metadata compatibility revision leaves experimental code, protocols, evidence and scientific conclusions unchanged.
